data.one_liner: Marker Geo-Animation solution for Google Maps.
data.what_it_does: Provides a widget-based solution to smoothly animate marker position changes on Google Maps. It supports multiple markers simultaneously, marker rotation based on heading direction, ripple effects, and custom animation curves and durations.
use_when: You need to animate marker movements smoothly on Google Maps like in a delivery or ride-sharing app.
You require features like marker rotation/bearing, ripple effects, and multipoint linear animations.
avoid_when: You are using a mapping solution other than Google Maps.
You only need static markers without any position interpolation or animation.
strengths: Supports multiple markers animating at the same time.
Includes built-in support for marker rotation and ripple effects.
weaknesses: Geolocation and Google Maps configuration are out of the scope of the package.
data.setup_notes: Requires Google Maps configured in your Flutter project; geolocator or location updates must be handled separately.
data.minimal_example:
Animarker(
	curve: Curves.ease,
	markers: markers.values.toSet(),
	child: GoogleMap(
		mapType: MapType.normal,
		initialCameraPosition: kSantoDomingo,
		onMapCreated: (gController) => controller.complete(gController),
	),
)
